archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Grand Theft Auto VI reaches $3.79 billion in first-day retail sales

entries.headline: Grand Theft Auto VI draws about 20,000 Metacritic user ratings
entries.summary: Metacritic had received about 20,000 user ratings at the time of the report, averaging 5.4 out of 10. Positive and negative ratings were nearly evenly split, with praise for the world and criticism of frame-rate drops and bugs.
entries.verification: The opened media report supports the snapshot; counts and scores are time-bound.
entries.timeNote: Published within the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Grand Theft Auto VI reaches $3.79 billion in first-day retail sales
entries.summary: Take-Two and Rockstar confirmed $3.79 billion in retail sales during the first 24 hours and 32.5 million pre-sale units. The game launched on November 19 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.
entries.verification: The opened IGN report explicitly attributes the figures to Take-Two and Rockstar.
entries.timeNote: Published within the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: AUTOMATON reports on Ubisoft’s earlier job cuts and Motherbrain announcement
entries.summary: AUTOMATON’s report falls within this edition’s window; the underlying disclosures predate it. Ubisoft cut 166 roles across its Montreal and Quebec teams and separately announced Motherbrain, a game AI subsidiary working on areas such as NPCs with persistent memory. The report does not establish a direct causal link.
entries.verification: The opened report attributes both the job cuts and studio announcement to Ubisoft and its financial presentation.
entries.timeNote: Published within the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Internet 4 brings an eight-player shared browser to Steam Early Access
entries.summary: Developer Xiick announced a shared-browser game for up to eight players, with activities such as fishing and drawing. The Windows version is due in Steam Early Access on December 4.
entries.verification: The opened report ties the concept, player count, date and platform to the developer announcement and store page.
entries.timeNote: Published within the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: 1666: Amsterdam schedules its first major Early Access update for December
entries.summary: Panache Digital Games says the update will add Ouderkerk, a region slightly larger than the current area, plus new supernatural abilities and another Original. The Early Access price will remain unchanged.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report explicitly attributes the update scope and pricing to the developer.
entries.timeNote: Published within the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Baptiste moves to March 25, 2027
entries.summary: Digital Dreams and Firenut Games delayed the psychological horror title from fall 2026 to March 25, 2027, for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2 and PC.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report states the old window, new date and platform scope.
entries.timeNote: Published within the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Dual Orb Collection brings two Super Famicom RPGs to Switch
entries.summary: Mebius announced a collection of Dual Orb and Dual Orb II for Nintendo Switch, due March 18, 2027 in Japan.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report states the contents, date, platform and region.
entries.timeNote: Published within the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Saihate Station: Twilight Edition heads to Switch on March 25, 2027
entries.summary: PLAYISM and viv announced a Switch package containing the base game, Twilight Railway DLC and two mini-games. It is due worldwide with Simplified and Traditional Chinese among its supported languages.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report states the package contents, worldwide date, platform and language support.
entries.timeNote: Published within the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Zenless Zone Zero version 3.4 launches December 2
entries.summary: The Finality of the Day brings the Roscaelifer storyline to its climax, adds Sunbringer, and begins the Honkai: Star Rail crossover with Robin and Kafka as crossover Agents.
entries.verification: The opened report supports the update facts; the official miHoYo page was used only to verify Chinese terminology.
entries.timeNote: Published within the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: OpenTracks allows rhythm-game use under its standard license, with credits required for new titles
entries.summary: OpenTracks, formerly DOVA-SYNDROME, says music and rhythm games may use its tracks under the standard license. Games first released from January 1, 2027 must credit the track title and composer; credits are optional for earlier releases. The license and help pages will be updated on December 1, 2026.
entries.verification: The opened report attributes the revised policy to OpenTracks' November 20 notice.
entries.timeNote: Published within the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Grand Theft Auto VI drops a long-running sex-work mechanic
entries.summary: The report says the game no longer lets players use the series' former sex-work mechanic. Rockstar told Shacknews that implemented systems were chosen to serve Jason and Lucia's story, emotions and motivations.
entries.verification: The opened report combines observed mechanics with an explicitly attributed Rockstar explanation.
entries.timeNote: Published within the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Final Fantasy Resonance ranks sixth in U.S. game sales for October
entries.summary: The report says the October 22 release still placed sixth overall and fourth among new releases in the U.S. monthly chart. It also cites a Steam concurrent-player peak of about 43,000 at the time of reporting.
entries.verification: The opened report supports the rankings and time-bound concurrency figure; neither is extrapolated into unit sales.
entries.timeNote: Published within the fixed edition window.
